run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T08:07:46Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is a downstream symptom of a broken checkout deployment. The checkout Deployment in otel-demo was rolled out (revision 2, replicas swapped to ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b) at 08:16:24 with the same image but with KAFKA_ADDR changed from kafka:9092 to kafka:9999, a port the kafka Service does not expose (it exposes only 9092/9093). The new checkout container logs repeated 'Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout', exited with code 2, and the pod is now NotReady with a BackOff event. Error spans appear only on the checkout call path: frontend POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect, plus frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'. frontend-proxy ingress error spans stepped from a near-zero baseline to 54 per 60s in the minute ending 08:18:00 and then ran 68-92/min, immediately after the 08:16:24 rollout, which is what drives the alert. Note the alert is reported as firing since 08:07:46, about 10 minutes before that step; the alert rule itself returned no data, so its threshold/expression is unknown. Kafka itself is running, ready, configured to listen on 9092/9093 and actively logging; payment records no error spans and checkout logged 'payment went through'; all flagd fault flags are default off.

claims.text: frontend-proxy ingress spans with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR were at a near-zero baseline (0-6 per 60s) through the interval ending 08:17:00, then jumped to 54 in the interval ending 08:18:00 and stayed at 68-92 per 60s through 08:26:30, the last returned point.

In the 600s ending 08:31:37 the error spans of frontend and frontend-proxy are confined to the checkout path: frontend POST (228.2), POST /api/checkout (228.2), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (228.2), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (228.2) and tcp.connect (23.0), plus frontend-proxy 'ingress' (229.3) and 'router frontend egress' (228.2); frontend GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, CartService/AddItem and CartService/GetCart all returned 0 error spans.

Service-level error-span increase was 0 for frontend and frontend-proxy through the point at 08:16:46 and then rose sharply (frontend 125.6 in the next 300s point, climbing to ~820; frontend-proxy 66.7 climbing to ~400), and over the 1471s lookback frontend reached ~1341.8 and frontend-proxy ~666.4 by 08:30:17.

The checkout Deployment in otel-demo applied a config-only revision: the old ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 07:43:06, scaled to 0) has KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, while the new ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b (created 08:16:24, replicas 1) has KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout. The Deployment is at generation 2, annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=2, Helm-managed by release otel-demo.

Events for otel-demo show the rollout at 08:16:24-08:16:27: Deployment checkout ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled up replica set checkout-849d65649b from 0 to 1', ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b SuccessfulCreate pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz, Deployment checkout 'Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0', ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb SuccessfulDelete of pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8, plus a Warning BackOff event for container checkout at 08:23:30.
The current checkout Deployment template sets container env KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999 while its own init container waits on 'nc -z -v -w30 kafka 9092', an internal inconsistency in the same pod template.

The kafka Service in otel-demo has ClusterIP 100.66.162.182 and exposes only ports 'plaintext' 9092 and 'controller' 9093; there is no port 9999. The kafka Deployment configures KAFKA_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093 and KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092, and the other Kafka clients accounting and fraud-detection use KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092; only checkout uses kafka:9999.

checkout pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz logs repeat 'Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' and 'kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' from 08:16:56 onward; the only PlaceOrder attempt logged is '[PlaceOrder]' at 08:20:02 followed by 'payment went through' at 08:20:02 and then the Kafka connection failures.

checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz is Running but not ready: its checkout container has lastState terminated with exitCode 2, reason Error, finishedAt 08:20:02, and state terminated with exitCode 2, reason Error, finishedAt 08:23:29; restartCount is 1, Ready=False with reason ContainersNotReady since 08:23:30.

Kafka itself shows no failure of its own: pod kafka-ff7884766-ntckh is Running, ready, restartCount 0, started 07:43:07, and its logs at 08:24:38-08:24:44 show normal KRaft snapshot/segment activity. Payment likewise records 0 error spans across the whole window (0 at every point from 07:56 to 08:30).

The checkout Deployment's revision-2 KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999 is the fault that reaches the failing path: the errors start within the minute after the 08:16:24 ReplicaSet swap, checkout's own logs show the resulting Kafka i/o timeout and container exit code 2, and the only failing requests are those that depend on CheckoutService/PlaceOrder.

checkout's own spans carry no error status: its traces_span_metrics_calls_total series shows only STATUS_CODE_UNSET (~836.9 spans in the 900s ending 08:31:00) and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, so its failure is visible in its pod state, exit codes and logs rather than its span status.

Jaeger's returned traces for frontend-proxy are newest at 08:05:13 (before the fault) and show the pre-fault behaviour: POST /api/checkout HTTP 200, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code 0, frontend-proxy ingress HTTP 200.

frontend and frontend-proxy pods are running with 0 restarts (frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-h7j7c), and ad, fraud-detection and recommendation show small error-span counts (about 1-3 per 1471s) that were already present before the deviation and did not step up with it, i.e. background rather than the cause.

No flagd fault flag is active: every flag in ConfigMap flagd-config (demo.flagd.json), including kafkaQueueProblems, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure and productCatalogFailure, has defaultVariant 'off'.
Kafka is not the failing component: its pod is ready with 0 restarts, its configured listener is 9092/9093, and accounting and fraud-detection use kafka:9092 while only checkout uses kafka:9999.
Payment is not the failing dependency: it records 0 error spans at every point of the window and checkout logged 'payment went through' immediately before the Kafka failure.

Rejected: that the kafka Service is missing a listener and is therefore the root object. The kafka Deployment itself declares listeners on 9092/9093 and advertises kafka:9092, the Service mirrors those ports, and the init container inside the very same checkout pod template uses 9092, so the wrong side is the checkout client address, not the Service.

Rejected: that frontend or frontend-proxy is itself the origin of the errors. Both pods are running with 0 restarts, and their error spans are limited to the checkout call path (PlaceOrder / POST /api/checkout / tcp.connect and the proxy's ingress and frontend egress spans); all other frontend operations had 0 error spans.

The alert is reported as firing since 08:07:46, about 10 minutes before the sharp error step at ~08:18; a plausible explanation is that the rule triggers on a rate above 0 and was already satisfied by the small pre-existing frontend-proxy ingress error baseline (0-6 per 60s), with the 08:17 checkout failure then driving the rate far higher. The rule expression and threshold could not be read, so this remains unverified.

Correct the checkout deployment source value that produced KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999 so it points at the kafka Service port (kafka:9092, as the init container and the accounting/fraud-detection clients already use), re-apply the release, and confirm the new checkout pod becomes Ready without Kafka i/o timeouts before treating the frontend-proxy alert as resolved.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so the actor, commit or Helm values change that produced checkout Deployment revision 2 at 08:16:24 could not be identified; the Deployment object itself is the deepest evidence available.

list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no data, so the alert's expression, threshold and evaluation interval are unknown; the reported firing time 08:07:46 could not be reconciled with the observed error step at ~08:17.

Jaeger returned no frontend or frontend-proxy traces newer than 08:05:13, so no failing trace (and no HTTP 5xx status or gRPC error detail on a failing PlaceOrder) could be inspected; error evidence comes from traces_span_metrics_calls_total instead.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv read 0 lines, so the frontend's own application log lines for the failing /api/checkout requests are unknown.
The networkpolicies query for otel-demo returned no objects (status no_data), so whether a policy exists or existed that could affect kafka:9999 traffic could not be verified.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available returned no series for namespace otel-demo/deployment checkout, so deployment-level readiness over time is unknown; pod-level state was used instead.

Logs of the previous checkout container instance were unavailable (HTTP 400 'previous terminated container not found') and the pre-rollout pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8 no longer exists, so its application logs could not be compared with the new pod's.
The cause of the drop in error counts per 300s window after about 08:27 (from ~835 to ~215 for frontend) could not be established; it is not explained by any observed object change.
next_steps: Inspect the Helm release/values history for otel-demo checkout (the source of Deployment revision 2 at 2026-11-17T08:16:24Z) to confirm which change set KAFKA_ADDR to kafka:9999 and who applied it.
Review the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition and threshold, and check whether it is intended to fire on a non-zero baseline, since it was reported firing before the 08:17 error step.

After a corrective rollout, re-check checkout pod readiness, container restart count and the absence of 'dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' in its logs, and re-check frontend POST /api/checkout and frontend-proxy ingress error spans over a comparable baseline window.
Separately investigate why Jaeger holds no traces after 08:05:13 while span metrics keep flowing, since that blind spot prevents trace-level confirmation of failing requests.
